scope: V4 skyline additions ranked by actual sightline contribution from the saved interior cameras. Coordinates are WGS84; scene XY is produced by r4_geo.local_xy (single +33 m X registration).
ranking_method: For each candidate: local azimuth and distance from each saved interior camera, projected pixel height at 1800 px width (lens/36 mm * 1800 * (8+height-camera_z)/distance), and whether the azimuth falls in the camera's horizontal frustum. Apparent size and unobstructed contribution rank first, identity second. Occlusion by the bowl/canopy is checked in the rendered panoramas, not assumed.
